items.title: Suno argues that judge should throw out musician’s publicity rights lawsuit
items.summary: Suno is fighting several music industry lawsuits, but one stands out - filed by musician Jason Isbell - because it accuses the AI company of infringing publicity rights by connecting artist names to musical styles in the back-end. Suno has responded to that lawsuit, urging the judge to dismiss it

items.title: Elvis Presley Enterprises suing AI music generator company over copyright infringement
Meta Employees ‘Interacted’ With Pirated Copies of Adult Films, Filing Shows
items.summary: A newly unredacted court filing shows that Meta’s internal investigation found several employees who appear to have interacted with Strike 3’s adult films. The adult content producers say these were torrented copies listed in their lawsuit, but Meta says there is no evidence of torrenting. The company also stresses tha…

items.title: Suno Fires Back Against Apple’s Subpoena Opposition, Doubling Down on Its Push for Information About ‘Current License Negotiations,’ ‘Anti-AI Deal Terms,’ and More
items.summary: Suno is doubling down on its Apple subpoena push, arguing that the information being sought – about Apple Music’s major label licensing talks, “anti-AI deal terms,” and more – is central to its fair use and copyright misuse arguments. The AI music platform took aim at Apple’s motion to quash in a 24-page opposition fil…

items.title: Music industry intervenes in Open AI’s big legal battle with newspapers and authors
items.summary: All of the US music industry’s copyright lawsuits against AI companies swing on whether or not AI training is fair use under US law. A big legal battle involving authors, newspapers and Open AI also centres on fair use, and the music industry has now intervened in that case via an amicus brief

items.title: Nothing Illegal Here: Suno Moves to Dismiss Jason Isbell’s Class Action Lawsuit on First Amendment and US Copyright Law Grounds
items.summary: Suno moves to dismiss a right-of-publicity case filed by a group of performers, including Jason Isbell and David Lowery, claiming that none of its outputs could be mistaken for those musicians. Suno has filed a motion to dismiss the U.S. privacy and publicity rights claims filed by musicians Jason Isbell and David Lowe…

items.summary: Kroger asks a federal judge to toss Sony Music’s broad-ranging infringement case, claiming that the Cox v. Sony case ruling set the precedent that businesses can’t be liable for influencer posts. items.title: Elvis Presley Rights Owners Sue Suno Over AI Voice Cloning: ‘Elvis’ Identity Was Stolen’
items.summary: The singer's legendary voice is at the center of a cutting-edge lawsuit that aims to hold the AI firm legally liable for allowing users to create knockoff vocals.

items.title: Elvis Music Owners, Eminem Publisher File Sprawling New Lawsuits Against AI Music Generator Suno: ‘The Next Elvis Won’t Pick Up a Guitar’
items.summary: A collection of Elvis Presley music rightsholders and the publisher of many of Eminem’s records have filed sprawling new federal lawsuits against the AI music generator Suno, with each party making separate allegations that add to the AI company’s legal challenges. The Presley lawsuit — brought by a group that includes…

items.title: Rotor Videos opens Artist Unlimited to any artist from $9.99 a month, with unlimited release visuals and a library of 17M+, non-AI-generated clips
items.summary: The plans give artists unlimited access to Rotor's tools for making visual assets for release campaigns, including music videos, lyric videos, Spotify Canvas, and Apple Music Album Motion. Source

tip.title: Split sheet firmado el mismo día de la sesión
tip.body: Los porcentajes de autoría se pelean cuando la canción pega, no cuando se escribe. Firma el split sheet con todos los presentes antes de salir del estudio, aunque sean amigos.

tip.title: Sign the split sheet the day of the session
tip.body: Songwriting splits get disputed when the song blows up, not when it's written. Sign a split sheet with everyone in the room before you leave the studio —even with friends.
